name: Wholesale Dynamic Pricing Buttons
author: WPSAAD

sections.description:
🚀 Increase WooCommerce Sales with Bulk & Wholesale Pricing!

The Bulk Wholesale Dynamic Pricing Buttons for WooCommerce plugin makes it easy to offer bulk discounts, dynamic pricing, and wholesale pricing strategies for your WooCommerce store. Instead of complex pricing rules, this plugin dynamically displays pricing buttons based on quantity selection, improving customer experience and increasing conversions.

🔹 Key Features:

✔ Dynamic Pricing Buttons – Display bulk and wholesale price variations directly on the product page.
✔ Automatic Quantity Discounts – Set pricing discounts based on quantity selection.
✔ Works with Simple & Variable Products – Apply bulk pricing for different product variations.
✔ Customizable Button Styling – Customize button colors, hover colors, and text colors from the admin panel.
✔ Easy-to-Use Admin Interface – Configure global settings from the “Dynamic Pricing” menu in your WordPress admin.
✔ Per-Product Configuration – Set unique pricing tiers for each product using the “Bulk Pricing” metabox.
✔ Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Fully compatible with WooCommerce.
✔ Lightweight & Fast – No unnecessary bloating, ensuring fast page load speeds.

📢 Perfect for:

  • Wholesale Stores offering discounts for bulk buyers.
  • Retailers with tiered pricing strategies.
  • Businesses running special promotions or quantity-based discounts.

💼 Free Features:

✔ Display quantity-based pricing buttons on the product page
✔ Set fixed prices for each quantity tier
✔ Customize button colors and hover styles
✔ Supports simple and variable products
✔ Fully integrated with WooCommerce cart pricing
✔ Global settings panel accessible from WordPress admin menu
✔ Per-product pricing configuration

💎 Pro Features:

✅ Conditional Pricing Logic (≥, ≤, =, >, <) per quantity range
✅ Tiered Pricing Button Display with logic-based rendering
✅ Dynamic price update in cart with advanced logic
✅ Per Piece vs Per Quantity calculation modes
✅ Admin panel to customize logic behavior and colors
✅ Premium support and updates

📌 How It Works:

  1. Configure Global Settings – Go to “Dynamic Pricing” menu in WordPress admin to customize button colors and pricing method.
  2. Set Product Pricing – Edit any product and configure pricing tiers in the “Bulk Pricing” metabox.
  3. Dynamic Price Display – Pricing buttons automatically appear on product pages showing quantity-based discounts.
  4. Customer Chooses Quantity – Shoppers click a pricing button and quantity updates instantly.
  5. Auto-Applies at Checkout – Discounted pricing is automatically applied when customers add items to the cart.

sections.installation:
1. Install & Activate: Upload the plugin via Plugins > Add New, or install from WordPress.org.
  2. Configure Global Settings: Go to “Dynamic Pricing” menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  3. Set Product Pricing: Edit any WooCommerce product and add pricing tiers in the “Bulk Pricing” metabox.
  4. Enjoy Dynamic Pricing! Discounts apply automatically at checkout.
sections.faq:
🔹 Where do I find the plugin settings?

You’ll find a “Dynamic Pricing” menu item in your WordPress admin sidebar (with a money icon). Click it to access global settings like button colors and pricing calculation method. For per-product pricing, edit any product and look for the “Bulk Pricing” metabox.

🔹 Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce products?

Yes! It supports simple and variable products in WooCommerce.

🔹 Can I set different price levels for different quantities?

Yes! You can configure tiered pricing based on quantity selection. Each product can have unlimited pricing tiers configured in the “Bulk Pricing” metabox.

🔹 How do I add pricing tiers to a product?

Edit any WooCommerce product, scroll down to the “Bulk Pricing” metabox, click “Add Pricing Group”, then enter the quantity and price for each tier you want to create.

🔹 Can I customize the button colors?

Yes! Go to the “Dynamic Pricing” menu in your WordPress admin to customize button colors, hover colors, and text colors.

🔹 Will this modify my WooCommerce product prices?

No! The pricing changes only on the front-end display while keeping product prices intact in WooCommerce.

🔹 Is it compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes! This plugin works seamlessly with most WooCommerce add-ons and themes.

🔹 What’s the difference between “Per Piece” and “Per Quantity” pricing modes?

These options are available in the Pro version from the “Dynamic Pricing” admin menu. “Per Piece” calculates price per unit, while “Per Quantity” applies the price to the entire quantity range.

🔹 Not working?

  • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  • Check the “Dynamic Pricing” menu settings are configured correctly.
  • Verify you’ve added pricing tiers in the product’s “Bulk Pricing” metabox.
  • Clear your site cache if changes aren’t appearing.
